As one of the leading industry RAJSAGAR STEEL is 
 providing the superior quality of comprehensive ranges of 
IS 1239 
 PART 1 Pipes.
 We are globally dealing with the 
 national and international clients taking the orders in bulk and 
 fulfilling the demands of those as per the expectations they are having 
 from us. We are dealing as a manufacturer, supplier, and exporter and 
 stockiest of the varieties of pipes that are today extensively used in 
 many industrial applications. It is found used in various zones like 
 plant piping, irrigation, and agriculture, etc. To the industrialists, 
 these pipes are made available at various sizes, dimensions, length, etc 
 and also as per the client’s demands as well.
Our comprehensive inventory and logistics capabilities 
 mean we can fulfill orders for IS 1239 PART 1 Pipes in Rajkot, Surat, 
 Ankleshwar, Vapi or anywhere else with ease.
IS 1239 PART 1 Mild Steel Pipes, IS 1239 Pipe Dealer in Surat, IS 1239 Part

Features of the pipes-
 Due to many good features IS1239 PART 1 Pipes are having the 
 demand and its usability has got greatly increased. The features 
 that is responsible for making these pipes a good choice for 
 various applications are-
 • High tensile strength
 • Corrosion-resistant
 • High toughness
 • Deformability
 • Rugged construction
 • Anti-corrosive body
 • Long-lastingness
About the production of 
 pipes-
 The manufacturing of 
IS 1239 PART 1 MS Pipes 
is 
 executed under the tight supervision of professional experts. 
 They as are having very good skills and knowledge of the 
 construction of pipes thus guiding our workers at various levels 
 of production stages for the development of superior quality of 
 pipes as per the clients’ demands. The manufacturing of the 
 offered ranges of pipes is done by effectively using the 
 superior quality of alloy that we have sourced from reliable 
 market mills and are well tested and quality assured. We are 
 also making the effective use of sophisticated technology and 
 modern tools for adding greater strength to the quality of the 
 pipe.
Product quality checking-
 Quality checking of the manufactured and offered ranges of 
 IS1239 PART 1 Pipes at our industry is done through several 
 testing. The testing helps us to make sure about how good is the 
 quality of the pipe that we are providing. Certain tests we 
 conduct are positive material identification test, mechanical 
 test, chemical test, pitting resistance test, hydrostatic test, 
 ultrasonic test, radiography test, macro test, micro test, bend 
 test, flattening test, flaring test, intergranular corrosion 
 test, etc.
Test certifications-
 The test certification offered by us to all our esteem patrons 
 is manufacturer test certifications as per En 10204/3.1b, buyers 
 test report, third party inspection report, 100% radiography 
 test report, and raw material certificate.
Documents of the product-
 There are many essential documents we are providing to the 
 clients when the ordered product is shipped to them. The 
 documents we provide are fumigation certificate, commercial 
 invoice, welding specifications, NABL approved lab test report, 
 guarantee letter, packaging list, heat treatment chart, quality 
 assurance plan, etc. All the documents that we provide are good 
 enough at assuring the buyers that we are delivering the 
 superior quality of pipes to them that can be used at any 
 condition.
Packaging-
 We are doing the 
IS 1239 Black ERW Pipe
packaging as per standard packaging norms. It is packed 
 into wooden cases, wrapped in environmental poly bags and 
 bundles.
